capabilities: Render nested Markdown schedules as grouped blocks in a sidebar timeline
Edit nested items, task state, ordering, and attachments from the timeline
Show scheduled Tasks and ICS calendar events (Google, iCloud, Outlook) on the timeline
Track time per task or file with clock-in/clock-out records stored as Dataview properties
Keep overnight plans anchored to their start day's daily note
extras: Users must disable the original Day Planner plugin before enabling this fork in the same vault. Requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or newer. Only the time-tracking feature is marked experimental; it can be turned off in settings.
intentEvidence: Day Planner Enhanced is an independent MIT-licensed fork of Obsidian Day Planner.
problem: In the original Day Planner timeline, nested child items appear again as separate Timeline or All Day entries, so nested daily plans lose their structure in the sidebar.

relations.evidence: Day Planner Enhanced is an independent MIT-licensed fork of Obsidian Day Planner.
Tasks anywhere in your vault can appear on the timeline when they have a scheduled date
Enable either the core Daily Notes plugin or the Periodic Notes community plugin.
record time spent on tasks in the form of Dataview properties

summary: Fork of the Day Planner plugin that renders nested Markdown schedules as readable sidebar timeline blocks with nested editing, calendar feeds, and time tracking.
